description: Entreprises - Transports - Transport ferroviaire is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by STATEC Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg. This dataset includes the following resources: - Length of lines and tracks in operation (km) - Rolling stock - CFL revenue and expenditure (EUR 1 000) - Central government subsidies to CFLs (in EUR 1 000) - Goods traffic - Passenger traffic (rail and road) - CFL road transport --- Automatically synced from the LUSTAT ... Coverage: STATEC Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg. The portal shows the English title as "Companies - Transport - Rail transport" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is STATEC Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg. Its keywords include entreprises, transport, statec-sync, statistics, transports, rail. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-zero. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
